canonical_data: human-readable memory and profile files, SQLite session history, agent-created skills, schedules, and per-profile configuration
strengths: Persistent memory, searchable sessions, agent-authored skills, schedules, and profiles form a coherent long-lived runtime
Local, container, SSH, and hosted sandbox backends support materially different execution boundaries
Messaging channels, browser and terminal tools, MCP, and multi-agent bot mode provide a broad operational surface
weaknesses: Skill and memory writes are autonomous by default unless optional approval gates are enabled
The combination of shell access, messaging channels, schedules, remote backends, and self-editing skills requires careful hardening
Fast growth and a broad integration surface leave less operational history than older runtimes
why_it_matters: A notable open implementation of a personal agent that treats memory, learned skills, schedules, channels, and execution policy as durable runtime state.
